options: A firm earns extra profits from selling goods
A third party receives benefits without paying for them

Consumers pay more than the equilibrium price

question: Which market structure is characterized by many sellers offering identical products with no barriers to entry?
options: Monopoly
Oligopoly
Perfect competition
Monopolistic competition
